storage_contract.description: Per-column source coverage of every observed *_versions table, aligned with docs/source_field_audit.md. ROADMAP step 14.

coverage_terms.sourced: an inspected official endpoint publishes the value for the whole v1 window and both markets
coverage_terms.partially_sourced: published for only some dates, markets, or securities; audit section 5 lists every one
coverage_terms.unsourced: no inspected source publishes it; the column stays NULL and no v1 PR may promise it
coverage_terms.internal: identity, interval boundary, or provenance linkage that is not expected to come from a source field

storage_contract.source_fields_note: Exact published column labels where the audit records them; where the audit certifies a whole table instead (4.3, 4.4, 4.5), the endpoint is named.

excluded_tables.corporate_action_retractions: Append-only record that a range file's covered window no longer lists a locator it once did (ROADMAP Step 19-c). `reason` is our own classification, not source content, and the table has no business-content columns to audit.

security_transfer_events.reason: Official cross-market transfer terms, retained for re-runnable reconciliation without merging source histories (audit 4.11).

entry_version_id.note: Link to the security_metadata_versions row that opens the new venue.

from_source.note: Identity of the source history the security transferred out of.

source_fields: market of the prior venue snapshot feed
from_market.note: The venue the security left, as its own snapshot feed published it.

source_term.note: The source's own wording for the transfer, kept verbatim.

tdcc_distribution.reason: The per-level rows of one TDCC weekly snapshot (audit 4.9).

snapshot_version_id.note: Link to the tdcc_snapshot_versions row the rows belong to.

bucket_code.note: The numeric level, 1-17; see the codebook in audit 4.9.

tdcc_distribution_schema_buckets.reason: One level of a recovered TDCC codebook (audit 4.9).

bucket_role.note: Our classification of the level as a band, an adjustment row, or a total: level 16 carries two different labels across securities, so the role cannot be assumed from the number.

description.note: The published band, for example 1,000-5,000 for level 2.

tdcc_distribution_schemas.reason: The TDCC holding-level codebook recovered in audit 4.9. The bulk file never states the share band a level means.

distribution_schema.note: Our name for one recovered codebook version.

description.note: The 1-17 band labels, identical in all 1,849 files of the deleted shareholding_div reconstruction.

tdcc_snapshot_versions.reason: TDCC OpenData getOD.ashx?id=1-5 for the latest week and the consolidated 375-week archive for history (audit 4.9).

security_id.note: Stable Data Center identity resolved from the source security code.

snapshot_date.note: Keyed on the column, never on the filename: two archive files are named for their download date and carry an earlier 資料日期 (audit 4.9).

distribution_schema.note: The numeric level codebook 1-17 recovered in audit 4.9. Level 16 carries two different labels across securities, so a parser must not assume 16 is the adjustment row.

trading_calendar_versions.reason: TWSE afterTrading/FMTQIK, one request per month listing every actual trading day (audit 4.12). The version is month-grained because the month is the artifact and the revision unit: a closure is an absence from the day list, so correcting one changes the list and produces a new version.

source_fields: publishing venue of the monthly report
market.note: FMTQIK is the TWSE market report. No official TPEx trading-day source was found, so no TPEx row may be written (ROADMAP 22, step 16).

calendar_month.note: One report per calendar month; the month is the request key.

trading_days.note: Every actual trading day the report lists. July 2024 omits the 07-24/25 typhoon closures, so an absence is the closure.

coverage_through.note: The last date this version can speak for. A month fetched before it ends publishes a partial list, and days after this bound are unknown, never closed.

xbrl_concept_catalog_versions.reason: Not in v1 (ROADMAP 16). The legacy xbrl_codebook table is read by no consumer and this audit inspected no official concept-catalogue endpoint.

concept_qname.note: No official concept-catalogue endpoint was inspected; the audit covers only the iXBRL documents themselves (4.8).

statement_type.note: No official concept-catalogue endpoint was inspected.

account_name_zh.note: No official concept-catalogue endpoint was inspected.

account_name_en.note: No official concept-catalogue endpoint was inspected.
